title: Every bus and train in Houston in 24 hours
description:
Every bus and train running in Houston on an average October weekday, from the morning rush to the next morning, in 50 seconds.

I took the October 2026 timetables, kept the trips that run on at least half of the weekdays, and put each vehicle where its schedule says it is. The count is the average for that minute and only includes vehicles inside the Houston city limits. The faded ones are just outside. Colours: Local, Park & Ride, Express and Rail.

Busiest moment: 617 vehicles at 5:00 pm.
The weekday average uses every October 2026 weekday in each timetable and leaves out Columbus Day (October 12).

Houston METRO (Metropolitan Transit Authority of Harris County): METRO Data Use Agreement. Route and arrival data provided by permission of METRO.
